# Dataset Index

Contract version: `v1`

Validation command: `npm run verify:data`

## Source priority

1. `apk-unity-artifacts` - APK/Unity artifacts first
   Start with repo-local APK and Unity package artifacts plus the extraction outputs committed from them.
2. `official-public-corroboration` - Official/public corroboration second
   Use official or public game-facing sources to verify terminology, labels, and player-facing presentation.
3. `community-gap-filling` - Community gap-filling last
   Use community sources only to fill documented gaps or support clearly labeled external-model behavior.
